title: Motor Vehicle Crash
summary: Scene management through the crash report.

steps.text: Position the vehicle to protect the scene; lights on
Check for injuries and request EMS and fire as needed
Look for hazards: fuel, fire, wires, hazmat placards
Identify drivers, passengers and witnesses; exchange information
Photograph vehicles, final rest positions, debris and road marks
If a driver left the scene, get the vehicle description and direction
Issue summonses where the facts support them

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
